sahneler.metin: A cargo ship crashed into the Sidney Lanier Bridge in Georgia.
Spans fell into the river, and ten people were killed.
It was a low vertical-lift bridge.
Cars on the bridge plunged into the water.
It was one of two ship collisions it suffered.
Larger ships later couldn't reach the port at all.
The replacement was built higher, with protective islands.

aciklama:
Sidney Lanier Bridge had spans knocked down by a ship. The cause: ship impact on a low vertical-lift bridge with poor navigational clearance.
